_comment: Character types offered in the 'My character' tab. Edit freely; reload the page to see changes.
id: stable key stored in settings (lowercase letters, digits, underscores). Don't rename one that is in use.
label: shown in the dropdown. description: shown under it.
guidance: not used by per-image analysis; the guide-building stage uses it to shape the self-style and content guides.
Keys starting with '_' and any other unknown keys are ignored.

character_types.label: Influencer
character_types.description: Lifestyle-led personal brand: relatable, aspirational, consistent across many posts.
character_types.guidance: Favour a recognisable, repeatable signature look that works in everyday settings and phone-camera light. Balance aspiration with approachability.

character_types.label: Fashion Model
character_types.description: Editorial and commercial fashion work where the clothes and silhouette lead.
character_types.guidance: Prioritise silhouettes, proportions, posing range and versatility across styles over a single fixed look. Hair and makeup should stay adaptable.

character_types.label: Cosplay Character
character_types.description: Portrays existing or original characters through costume, wig and makeup.
character_types.guidance: Treat the base look as a canvas: note which features help or hinder transformation (face shape, build, colouring) and which costume and wig colours suit them out of character.

character_types.label: Fitness Creator
character_types.description: Training, sport and active lifestyle content.
character_types.guidance: Emphasise activewear, movement-friendly styling, energetic posing and settings like gyms and outdoors. Hair and makeup should read as low-maintenance.

character_types.label: Beauty Creator
character_types.description: Makeup, skincare and hair content, often in close-up.
character_types.guidance: Weight colour analysis, skin undertone and face shape heavily. Close-up framing and flattering light matter more than full outfits.

character_types.label: Glamour Model
character_types.guidance: Lean into dramatic light, confident posing, luxurious settings and a polished hair and makeup finish.

character_types.label: Alternative / Alt Creator
character_types.description: Goth, punk, grunge, e-girl and other subculture aesthetics.
character_types.guidance: Build the style around subculture signifiers (dark palettes, layering, statement hair and makeup) while keeping what flatters the character's colouring.

character_types.label: Lifestyle / Travel Creator
character_types.description: Destinations, daily life, food and experiences.
character_types.guidance: Favour candid, environmental framing and outfits that suit varied locations and climates. The setting is often the co-star.

character_types.label: Musician / Performer
character_types.description: Artist persona built around music, stage and performance.
character_types.guidance: Develop a distinctive persona look that reads on stage and in promo shots; allow bolder statements than everyday styling.

character_types.label: Virtual Idol / VTuber
character_types.description: A stylised character persona, often anime-inspired.
character_types.guidance: Keep the look highly consistent and iconic: signature hair, a defined colour scheme and recognisable outfit motifs.
